snippet.title: Tyler's White Lie
snippet.description:
Alright, full transparency? I fumbled my dev-time and forgot to add the story. So even though this is technically a demo, I won't lie, this is probably
all this game will entail for the foreseeable future. Oh well. 

This was made for the LISA Game-jam in Stag's Bazaar.
Here's the download: https://gamejolt.com/games/tylerwhitelie/879493
~40 mins of game
~No-frills game design.
~Track was made by Rookie1978, called Grinnash: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=t94ntyYm6dQ&t=3882s
